bloques.titulo: Double function of the attribute Partizip II
texto: 1. **Con verbos transitivos (con haben)**: It has meaning **pasivo y resultativo**. The noun receives the completed action: **die gelieferten Sensoren** (the delivered sensors), **die beschädigte Dichtung** (the damaged joint).

2. **Con verbos intransitivos de cambio o movimiento (con sein)**: It has meaning **activo y de acción perfecta terminada**: **der angekommene Zug** (the train that has arrived), **die gesunkenen Kosten** (the costs that have fallen).
It is never used with intransitive verbs that govern «haben» and express duration (* * das geschlafene Kind * is not admissible in formal German).

filas: der Zug, der sich verspätet hat
die Waren, die aussortiert worden sind

frases.de: Wurden alle eingebauten Komponenten vor dem Testlauf gründlich überprüft?
frases.es: ¿Fueron minuciosamente revisados todos los componentes instalados antes de la prueba?
frases.en: Were all the components installed before the test thoroughly reviewed?

frases.de: Ja, die neu gelieferten Sensoren entsprechen den strengen Sicherheitsnormen.
frases.es: Sí, los sensores recién suministrados cumplen las estrictas normas de seguridad.
frases.en: Yes, the newly supplied sensors meet the strict safety standards.

frases.de: Und was geschieht mit den beschädigten Dichtungen?
frases.es: ¿Y qué ocurre con las juntas dañadas?
frases.en: And what about the damaged joints?

frases.de: Die aussortierten Teile sind bereits ersetzt und fachgerecht entsorgt worden.
frases.es: Las piezas descartadas ya han sido sustituidas y eliminadas conforme a norma.
frases.en: The discarded parts have already been replaced and removed according to standard.
analisis: discarded in accordance with the standard

bloques.pregunta: In the «die gelieferten Sensoren» expression, what is the relationship of the participle to the noun?

opciones.texto: Liabilities and results: the sensors were supplied by the supplier.
opciones.explicacion: The Partizip II of a transient verb attributes the action suffered by the object.

opciones.texto: Current active: Sensors are delivering packages to technicians.
opciones.explicacion: Sensors don't deliver anything, they're the ones.

opciones.texto: The hypothetical future: the sensors may be manufactured next year.
opciones.explicacion: Describe a state concluded after actual delivery.

bloques.frase: Der Ingenieur untersuchte die ___ Bauteile vor dem Einbau.

opciones.explicacion: After «die» in plural accentuative the particival adjective takes the weak deinence «-».
It would be the termination of singular feminine or neutral nomination.
It would be active Partizip I («que suministran»).

bloques.pregunta: What was done with the defective parts?
bloques.frase: Die aussortierten Teile sind fachgerecht entsorgt worden.

opciones.texto: Se apartaron y se eliminaron siguiendo rigurosamente las normas técnicas de gestión.
opciones.explicacion: «aussortiert» indicates prior separation and «entsorgt» waste management.

opciones.texto: They were reinstalled in the turbines to save maintenance costs.
opciones.explicacion: The text indicates that they were removed and removed immediately.

opciones.texto: They were sent to the customers as a gift of commercial courtesy.
opciones.explicacion: The pieces were useless and were treated as waste.

bloques.pregunta: Why is it possible to say «der angekommene Zug», but NOT «*das gearbeitete Personal»?

opciones.texto: Because «ankommen» is an intransitive verb of change that forms time with «sein».
opciones.explicacion: Only «sein» intransitives support an attribute Partizip II with a finished active sense.

opciones.texto: Because «arbeiten» is an irregular verb that has no participle finished in «-t».
opciones.explicacion: «gearbeitet» is the regular participle, but does not support adjetival adjective function.

opciones.texto: Because «Personal» is a collective noun that does not accept any adjective.
opciones.explicacion: Accepts normal adjectives («qualifiziertes Personal»), but not incompatible participles.

bloques.frase: Alle ___ Dokumente müssen im Firmenarchiv für zehn Jahre aufbewahrt werden.

opciones.explicacion: With «alle» (plural determinant) the participle II takes the «-» desinence.
It is the desinence without article or singular.
It would be Partizup I («que firman»).

bloques.pregunta: What does this quality report communicate?
bloques.frase: Die eingebauten Komponenten erfüllen alle geforderten Qualitätskriterien.

opciones.texto: That the parts that were installed meet the required technical requirements.
opciones.explicacion: Both participles («eingebaut» and «gefordert») function as a resultant attribute.

opciones.texto: That the inspectors have rejected all the parts for serious mounting defects.
opciones.explicacion: It states precisely that they meet all the requirements («erfüllen»).

opciones.texto: That the pieces have not yet been manufactured in the central factory.
opciones.explicacion: The parts are already made and integrated into the equipment.

bloques.frase: die gelieferten Sensoren entsprechen den Normen
bloques.traduccion: the sensors provided meet the standards
bloques.explicacion: the attribute participle II with prepositional regime.

intro: We analyze the **Partizip II** according to adjetival attribute: its passive value with transitive verbs and its perfect resultive value with intransitive verbs.
